description:
About Wonderschool 

 Wonderschool’s mission is to ensure every child has access to early childhood education that helps them realize their full potential. We empower small business owners, childcare providers, to launch and grow programs through software, coaching, and support, while partnering with governments to modernize childcare infrastructure.

 We are building a category-defining platform at the intersection of marketplace, SaaS, and public sector systems, now increasingly powered by AI. Our products help providers run and grow their businesses, from enrollment and marketing to licensing, compliance, and daily operations.

 Our team is small, fast-moving, and deeply focused on building systems that scale. We value people who take ownership, experiment quickly, and use modern tools, including AI and automation, to increase their leverage and impact.

 Position Summary 

 This role builds the core systems that power Wonderschool’s platform, enabling providers to launch and grow their businesses, governments to operate programs at scale, and families to access care. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you will own features end-to-end, working across frontend, backend, and data layers to deliver high-quality, scalable products.

 You will operate as a builder, partnering closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams to turn real-world problems into simple, effective solutions. Success in this role means shipping quickly, improving system reliability, and leveraging modern tools, including AI, to increase development velocity and product impact.

 Responsibilities 

 Build and Own Product End-to-End 

 
 Design, build, and ship full-stack features that improve provider, parent, and government experiences

 Own the full development lifecycle, from scoping and architecture to implementation and production support

 Write high-quality, maintainable code with strong test coverage

 Debug and resolve production issues across the stack

 
 Drive Product Impact 

 
 Partner closely with Product, Design, and Data to build features that solve real customer problems

 Develop a deep understanding of customer workflows and use cases

 Contribute to product decisions through technical insight and tradeoff analysis

 Work closely with GTM teams to understand user needs and improve product outcomes

 
 Improve Systems and Scale 

 
 Design systems and data models that support complex workflows and integrations

 Improve performance, scalability, and reliability of the platform

 Contribute to architecture decisions and technical direction

 Help evolve engineering standards, tooling, and best practices

 
 Increase Engineering Leverage 

 
 Use AI tools, automation, and modern development workflows to increase speed and efficiency

 Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve developer productivity

 Contribute to a culture of rapid iteration and continuous improvement

 
 Required Qualifications 

 
 6+ years of experience as a full stack engineer

 Strong experience with modern frontend technologies (React, TypeScript, JavaScript)

 Proficiency with backend systems (Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir, or similar)

 Experience working with relational databases (Postgres or similar)

 Proven ability to deliver high-quality code with strong testing practices

 Experience building and shipping production systems end-to-end

 Strong collaboration and communication skills

 
 Preferred Qualifications 

 
 Experience building complex or enterprise-grade systems with multiple integrations

 Experience designing APIs (REST or GraphQL)

 Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containerization, or serverless architectures

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices

 Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

 Experience incorporating AI into products or development workflows

 
 Compensation & Benefits 

 Compensation Range (California):
The base salary range for this role is $180,000 – $220,000, depending on experience, skills, and location. This role may also be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation.

 Wonderschool offers a competitive benefits package, including:

 
 Health benefits with up to 100% coverage for employee premiums and up to 80% for dependents

 Wifi and employee wellness stipends

 Flexible PTO, paid holidays, and mental wellness days

 Competitive parental leave (eligible after 6 months of employment)

 A highly collaborative, mission-driven workplace environment

 
 Location / Travel Expectations 

 This role is based in our office in Rincon Hill, San Francisco. We work in-office 5-6 days a week to enable close collaboration across engineering, product, and leadership teams.
